reason: mysql2/database_statements.rb:119 `ActiveRecord::Result.new(fields, raw_result.to_a)` leaves column types to the adapter's type map, which is keyed by the MySQL type name the C driver exposes on the result. node's mysql2 surfaces per-field type metadata only on the raw result, so `buildColumnTypes(rawResult.fields, ...)` resolves them here and passes them as Result's third (optional) argument.
